## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- CA Program Partners management, supervisors, engineers and health and safety staff are to carry out daily monitoring and observations of the workplace as they pass through and record positive and negative observations as applicable.
- Supervisors have a key responsibility for the health and safety of workers under their control and are to continually assess and be constantly on the lookout for any hazard that might arise in the work areas and take action where necessary.

Monitoring activities should include all thefollowing elements:

## 2.4.2.4.1.1.Inspections (Surveillances):

- Program Partners are to develop a schedule of regular Inspections across all sites toassess cormpliancc with lcgislation, conformance to health and safcty rcquircmcnts and identify safe/unsafe acts, conditions and behaviors.
- Health and safety inspections are to be recorded in an agreed format with copies of the reports.
- Results are to be analyzed on a monthly basis to identify positive and any negative trends.Where negative trends are identified Improvement Plans are to be developed to prevent recurrences.

## 2.4.2.4.1.2. Audits and Assessments:

- Program Partners shall develop an audit/assessment schedule to assess compliance with legislation, conformance to health and safety standards and toidentify corrective and preventive actions.
- As a minimum,Program Partners shall conduct monthly internal health and safety audits on their health and safety management system and the physical site conditions.
- EMAAR Misr is to be advised in advance of all audits and assessments to be performed in order to have the opportunity to attend and evaluate the thoroughness of the audit or assessment.
- EMAARMisr willconduct their own healthand safety audits or assessments toconfirm the effectivenessof theProgramPartnershealthandsafetymanagementsystem.
- Corrective actions resulting from audits and assessments are to be addressed holistically across the site and must be tracked until they are closed.Those that remain openpast their deadline date are to be recorded in the monthly HSE Report.

## 2.4.2.4.1.3. HSE Leadership Tours:

- Project Directors from EMAAR Misr, Consultant and Construction Supervision Consultants along with Contractors andmain sub-Contractors are to underlake atleastoneHSELeadershipTours cach Quartcr.
- The aim of the HSE Leadership Tour is for the Project Directors to engage with the workforce and visiblydemonstratetheircommitmcnttoHSEbyvisitingworksites topromotetheiimportanceof HSE arnd to gain further insight into the IISE issues being managcd.
- >To make the workplaces safer and more environmentally sustainable through:
- Accepting personal accountability for HSE management.

Yx Cg112-208
